title: Game Text Beacon
summary: Read game text aloud from a chosen screen region.
user: Blind and low-vision PC players who need an on-demand fallback for visually rendered game text.
smallest_useful_product: A Windows/Linux desktop helper that captures a chosen windowed-game region on hotkey, OCRs it locally, and queues speech without game automation.
constraints: Windowed or borderless only; no anti-cheat bypass, cloud screenshots, game assets, or DRM bypass.
